# The Washington Post

> The Washington Post is a leading digital news organization providing comprehensive coverage of breaking news, politics, national security, and global affairs with multimedia journalism.

The Washington Post delivers real-time news across politics, the Trump administration, national security, international affairs, and lifestyle topics. The site combines traditional reporting with visual journalism, interactive content, and opinion pieces from prominent columnists.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Breaking news
- National security
- White House
- Pentagon
- Iran conflict
- Politics
- Donald Trump
- Visual journalism
- Photo galleries
- Sports news
- Health coverage
- International affairs
- Opinion and commentary
- Interactive content

## News & Politics

- [The Washington Post - Homepage](https://www.washingtonpost.com/): Homepage with breaking news, politics, national security and global coverage
- [Latest From The Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/latest-headlines/): Breaking news and latest headlines from Washington Post across all topics
- [White House](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/white-house/): White House news, national security and executive branch coverage
- [Donald Trump](https://www.washingtonpost.com/donald-trump/): Comprehensive Trump administration coverage and political news analysis

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Washington Post Opinions](https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/): Opinion columns, editorials and commentary on politics and international affairs

## Visual Journalism

- [Photography](https://www.washingtonpost.com/photography/): Photography section featuring visual journalism, photo galleries and interactive content

## Sports & Recreation

- [Sports](https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/): Sports news, scores, analysis on local teams and major sporting events

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Health](https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/): Health and healthcare coverage including medical news, nutrition and fitness
- [Religion](https://www.washingtonpost.com/religion/): Religion and faith news covering spirituality, ethics and faith-related politics
- [Obituaries](https://www.washingtonpost.com/obituaries/): Obituaries and death notices for notable figures and community members

## Optional

- [Word Search](https://games.washingtonpost.com/games/word-search): Free online word search puzzle game with daily challenges
